newsitem.title: PERU: Peru to close Brady deal last week in Feb - paper.
newsitem.headline: Peru to close Brady deal last week in Feb - paper.

text.p: The Peruvian government was likley to formally close its Brady plan deal with commercial creditors in the last week of February, leading economic daily Gestion said Thursday.
Quoting government sources currently negotiating the debt restructuring deal in New York, Gestion said the precise date for the closing could be announced in the next few days.
Economy Ministry officials in Lima were not immediatley available to comment on the report.
Economy Minister Jorge Camet and other government officials arrived in New York Wednesday to finalize details of the Brady deal, Gestion said..

In November, the government signed a preliminary Brady bond debt accord with its commercial creditors containing most of the final details for the restructuring of $4.4 billion of principal and interest.
